ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will control the phone number format to ensure it fit Hungarian format, as following : +36-1-111-1111 (capital city) +36-11-111-111 (countryside)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c, 'HU'), NOT( OR( LEN(Phone) = 0, REGEX(Phone, "[+36]{3}-[0-9]{1}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{4}"), REGEX(Phone, "[+36]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{3}") )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The format of the Phone Number must be equal to Hungarian format, as following : +36-1-111-1111 (capital city) +36-11-111-111 (countryside)
